title: Intervención extranjera
goal: Read how both superpowers intervened directly in Latin America -- the 1954 CIA-backed coup in Guatemala, the 1965 US intervention in the Dominican Republic, and Soviet-Cuban support for guerrillas.
grammar: So pretexto de: una justificación oficial cuestionable

items: Explain what the CIA organized in Guatemala in 1954, and against whom.
State what the US did in the Dominican Republic in 1965, and its stated pretext.
Describe what the USSR and Cuba provided to regional guerrilla movements.
Explain what these official justifications usually concealed.
Use so pretexto de to flag an official justification as doubtful.
